title: 初一十五空四选：雨后的农场之行
instruction: 阅读下面完整短文，从每题四个选项中为第1—15空各选最合适的一项。
source_notice: 参照既存公开转载题首2024—2025第二学期期末七年级英语的一篇15空四选，每题1分共15分。武汉仅保留原转载地域标签，不从文件名补正文；原旅途温度食物和个人感受不当一般出行事实。本稿另编虚构游览。原校施测未认证、原键非gold；逐候选回填为作者自审，独立教研、学生难度/用时、商用与生产未验证。

sections.label: A
sections.passage:
Rain on our class trip to a farm made us (1) ____. We might have to stay on the bus! Luckily, it (2) ____ before we arrived.

A farmer gave each of us a (3) ____ for strawberries to take home. He showed us rows of plants. He asked us to walk (4) ____ them, not step on them.

My friend Kate found a big strawberry and called me over. It was under leaves, so I had to (5) ____ carefully. After picking six, I wanted (6) ____, but it was time for our next activity.

We washed our hands and made fruit (7) ____. We cut strawberries, apples and bananas into pieces and mixed them without water. Kate had no spoon, so I (8) ____ her my spare one. She returned it afterwards.

After lunch, we watched the farmer (9) ____ the hens, putting food in a dish. Then we carried empty (10) ____ to the gate for later visitors.

Before we left, I bought a little jar of strawberry jam for my (11) ____. I wanted her to try it on toast. On the way home, we talked about our (12) ____ parts of the visit. Kate liked the hens, but I liked making food (13) ____ my friends.

At home, I gave Grandma her jam. She asked if we had got (14) ____. “Not after we got there!” I said. It was a busy day, and I had a lot to (15) ____ her.
